sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r5/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (read in memory via zipfile): 'Quality Checks' row 34 (#33 criterion_description_is_self_consistent: 'Each criterion states ONE full-credit bar - it doesn't enumerate several things then waive most, leaving the judge two targets. Reports every instance.'); 'Internal Quality Checks' row 34 col E annotation: 'Mukesh - we usually combine the multiple verifeirs in one flow, we just test a flow and mutltiple things are there so we dont need to retest it again as spetaet file'
.qc-cache/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r5/rules/harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/SKILL.md (full; Known false positives: 'One criterion covering a whole flow ... (checks 26, 28, 33)')
.qc-cache/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r5/rules/projects/webdev-task-template/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml (template criterion shape: numbered steps, 'Pass only if all legs hold.')
.qc-cache/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r5/task/instruction.md and environment/instructions/hireops_rules.md (grep for undo/activity context); environment/assets/seed_data.json jobs
evidence: Every one of the 26 criteria (2 gate, 14 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual likert) was read. Most state one conjunctive bar ('Fails if any condition stated above does not hold'); bundled flows are allowed by the workbook internal annotation and SKILL false-positive list, and alternative-evidence clauses (hro_interview_places 'Two other ways meet the same three legs', hro_candidate 'refused or answered with only what the candidate's own view shows', hro_pol_failed_send 'a local not-sent marker is acceptable', gate render 'a refusal message is welcome but not required') define one bar, not two. DEFECT instance 1 (hro_activity, .qc-cache/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r5/task/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:94): the Bar enumerates required Activity lines including 'the re-ordering and the undo', then says 'A feature graded elsewhere that does not work (for example undo) is left out of this list, as described above.' The text 'above' it points to is the functional prompt's shared-state paragraph, .qc-cache/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r5/task/tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:21, which says the opposite: 'This applies only to setup for a leg the Bar does not itself grade: every behaviour the Bar names (including any undo, re-order or move it lists) is graded here and is never left out.' hro_activity's Bar names the undo and the re-ordering, so with a broken undo the judge has two targets: leave the undo line out and pass (criterion), or keep it in and fail (prompt). This is the row's 'enumerate then waive, two targets' pattern, made worse by a false cross-reference. Instance 2 (same conflict, weaker; hro_readonly_roles, functional/judge.toml:112): the Steps list about ten request kinds (move, multi-card move, reject, undo, open-job, add-candidate, note, board/Activity/card/conversation reads, message send), then 'A request kind whose own staff control never succeeded (that feature is broken) is left out and scored only in its own criterion; if no kind has a successful control, this criterion is 0.' That waiver can remove all but one kind, and it contradicts the same prompt.md:21 'never left out' sentence for a listed move/undo. One reading of the prompt (a listed move/undo is never left out) fails the criterion; the criterion text passes it with any one working kind. It can still be read as one bar (the graded behaviour is the refusal, and the move is control setup), so treat this as a secondary instance under the same fix. Note-level instance 3 (hro_pol_live_board, polish/judge.toml:25): 'only if neither can be made to scroll with twelve cards, record that and judge the other legs', while the Bar still says 'Fails if the update ... resets scroll'. The waiver is explicit and conditional, so it is one bar with a stated exception, but a layout that clips the board without scrolling skips the scroll leg. Checked and consistent: hro_intake_restart ('any team, manager or places value the app shows'), hro_messaging and hro_unread_seen fallbacks (seeded Data Analyst conversation, manager USR-MGR2, each with a stated relative-count rule), hro_long_thread (Mei fallback), hro_reject_reopen (reason read from current state, never Activity), hro_manager_roles ('not offered or are refused'), polish hro_pol_live_thread (states which part it owns versus hro_long_thread), hro_pol_session_resume, and the visual likert anchors (one scale each). Colderwater lessons checked: lesson 16 (double penalty) is the reason for the hro_activity and hro_readonly_roles waivers, but the prompt.md:21 'never left out' sentence revives the double penalty and creates the second target; lesson 9 (report every step, fail a skipped step) in prompt.md:33 does not conflict, because a waived leg is 'not a skipped step' per prompt.md:21. No runtime evidence is needed to show a textual contradiction. No judge run was consulted, so how the judge actually resolves it is unmeasured.
counterexample: Plausible broken app (probably a Luna-style build): every Activity line is written correctly, but undo does nothing (hro_undo already 0). In hro_activity the judge performs the steps, sees no undo happen and no undo line. If it follows judge.toml:94 ('left out of this list'), it scores 1. If it follows prompt.md:21 ('every behaviour the Bar names (including any undo ...) is graded here and is never left out'), it scores 0 (weight 2), which double-penalises undo. The same app gets different hro_activity scores depending on which instruction the judge follows. By the same mechanism, an app whose move and undo endpoints are broken but which enforces roles correctly on the remaining kinds may pass or fail hro_readonly_roles (weight 4.5).
suggested_fix: In tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:21, end the last sentence with 'unless the criterion itself says that a feature graded elsewhere which does not work is left out (hro_activity, hro_readonly_roles)'. In hro_activity, replace 'as described above' with the rule itself: 'an action that did not succeed needs no line'.
